hook: I fixed my whole closet system for under $200

scenes.visual_prompt: Before shot: cluttered closet with mismatched boxes, sagging shelf, loose items everywhere
scenes.voiceover: This was my closet three weeks ago.

scenes.visual_prompt: Quick cuts: clear bin 8-pack, under-bed bins with wheels, hanging shelf organizer, turntables, small item organizers, laid out on the floor like a flat-lay
scenes.voiceover: Clear bins, under-bed wheels, a hanging shelf, turntables, and small-item organizers — five products, one afternoon.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tangkula 4-tier stepped bookshelf being assembled, anti-tip hardware being anchored to the wall
scenes.voiceover: The one bigger investment is the shelf itself — $119.99, fixed and level, so the bins don't wobble.

scenes.visual_prompt: Fast time-lapse of the whole closet being assembled and filled, bins going onto shelf, labels applied, hanging organizer clipped on
After shot: full reveal, camera slow pans across the finished, uniform, labeled closet system
scenes.voiceover: This is the after. Everything has exactly one home now.

scenes.visual_prompt: Text overlay recapping total cost breakdown against a clean shot of the finished shelf
scenes.on_screen_text: the full breakdown is in my bio link
scenes.voiceover: Every product, every price, every review count — it's all in the post.

caption: The full before-and-after, with every product and price. Started with a $29.99 bin 8-pack and built out from there. Full breakdown, links, and review counts in my bio.
